name: Patience
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Make no mistake, champion--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
narrative.objectives: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
narrative.offerRewardText: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
narrative.requestItemsText: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
